title: 直壁精准低踏
description: 钢笔淡彩强调鞋尖落在清楚的低脚点上，双手保持轻松支撑。

art_direction.medium: soft pastel drawing with clear contour accents
art_direction.scene: An original ink-and-watercolor illustration depicts a fictional adult placing a shoe precisely onto a small but positive low foothold on a vertical bouldering wall. Both hands stay on generous amber holds, the supporting leg remains bent naturally, and the moving foot approaches without hopping. Show the whole body in a slightly low oblique medium-wide view so the target foothold and continuous crash mat are clear. Use delicate ink hatching, pale blue washes, and an opaque rust shirt with dark trousers. The next hold sequence stays compact and close to the floor. Preserve credible adult anatomy and contact points. No words, brands, leaps, exposed height, or landing obstructions.
